entries.sentence_en: From 1926 the cactus moth, Cactoblastis, cleared most prickly pear, an invasive cactus, from Queensland and New South Wales within about a decade.

entries.old_table_definition: 本文：蛾子；n. 蛾，飞蛾（like a moth to a flame 飞蛾扑火）

entries.sentence_en: Tested first, its larvae starved rather than eat fifteen other plants; the toads faced no such test.
